Say it the other way round

Yesterday the grass sail carried us away from the whirlpool, and on the shore a jar is rolling to a crack!

A party for all, even the ants! They are our new friends!

Glimmer warmed up in our hands and purrs.

The scarf is a home!

Yesterday we wrapped Glimmer in a scarf, and now he peeps out and shows the way!

We held hands!

Yesterday we held hands, and it grew as light as day, and suddenly a rainbow ladder flashed above us!

Yesterday we made a roof of the canopy, and there was a dry place for everyone underneath.

Pshhh!

The ball said "pshh" and went soft as a pancake. {fr} laughs: "Now it is a pancake match!"
final: Goal! Hooray! Champions!
{crowd} shout "hooray!", and {name} waves to everyone.
{crowd} shout "hooray!", {npc} tosses up a cap, and {name} and {fr} hug. The best day ever!
Victory, friends!
{rival} shakes hands, and now we are all one team.
{rival} smiles and shakes hands. Now the pitch has one big team, and everyone is having fun!

r: Roar of the crowd, ready, run!

open: We are {place_in}!
{name} and {fr} hurry {place_to} to warm up.
Today is {event}: running, jumping and swimming! {npc} waves little wings, and {crowd} are already clapping.
Sport, hooray!
{npc} buzzes: "Everyone to the start, friends!"
A bell rings, and {npc} buzzes: "To the start!" {name}, are you ready to run?
To the start!
The arena smells of rubber, and flags flutter in the wind.
The arena smells of new rubber, and flags flutter in the wind. {fr} is already doing squats!
fact: Medals have silver!
A gold Olympic medal is almost all silver.
Did you know? A gold Olympic medal is mostly silver, with a thin layer of gold on top.
Long ago, in Greece!
The first Olympic Games were in Greece over two thousand years ago.
Did you know? The first Olympic Games were held in Greece more than two thousand years ago, and they were repeated every four years.
The marathon is long!
Marathon runners run 42 kilometres and nearly 200 metres.
Did you know? Marathon runners run forty-two kilometres and almost two hundred metres more. That is a whole road between towns!
A spin on ice!
A skater spins faster than three turns a second.
Did you know? In a spin, a figure skater makes more than three turns a second and still stays on their feet!
fun: Laces!
The laces tied in a knot, and {fr} hops on the spot.
The laces on the trainers tied themselves in a bow, and {fr} hops on the spot like a grasshopper.
Splash! Into the pool!
A rubber duck jumped into the pool and swam front crawl.
A rubber duck jumped into the pool and swam faster than anyone. {crowd} roar with laughter and clap.
Wrong way!
{rival} runs backwards along the track, waving to everyone.
{rival} runs backwards along the track and is about to finish, but at the start. {crowd} laugh.
Bzzzz!
{npc} buzzes so loudly that the stopwatch jumps.
{npc} buzzes with joy so loudly that the stopwatch jumps and starts counting to ten by itself.
final: We are the winners!
{crowd} clap, and {name} jumps for joy.
{crowd} clap, {npc} circles overhead, and {name} and {fr} stand on the podium with their medals. We won!
The finish! Hooray!
{rival} laughs and gives everyone a little ball.
{rival} laughs and is the first to clap for the friends. Now everyone holds a medal and a kind smile!

l: Lap by lap, light and lively!

open: We are {place_in}!
{name} and {fr} hurry {place_to}.
Today is {event}! {npc} shines like a star, and {crowd} are already looking at the sky.
Three, two, one!
It is quiet {place_in}, and {npc} hums softly.
It is still quiet {place_in}, and only {npc} hums softly and whispers: "We fly soon!"
The stars wait!
Morning {place_in}: {npc} gleams and calls everyone.
Morning {place_in}: {npc} gleams in the sun and calls everyone. {name}, are you ready to fly to the stars?
fact: Footprints stay!
There is no wind on the Moon, so footprints last a very long time.
Did you know? There is no wind or rain on the Moon, so astronauts' footprints hardly fade and last a very long time.
Taller in space!
In space a person grows a few centimetres taller.
Did you know? In space, where there is no weight, the spine stretches and a person grows a few centimetres taller.
A day beats a year!
On Venus a day is longer than a year. What a strange day!
Did you know? On Venus, one spin on its axis takes longer than a whole year going round the Sun!
A blue sunset!
On Mars the sunset is blue, and the daytime sky is pinkish.
Did you know? On Mars the daytime sky looks pinkish, but the sunset around the Sun is blue. You can see it in photos.
fun: Atishoo!
{rival} sneezes, and all the moon dust swirls in the air.
{rival} breathes in dust and sneezes so loudly that the echo bounces off every crater.
Floating drops!
In zero gravity, tea does not pour. It floats in a ball.
In zero gravity tea does not pour but floats in little balls. {fr} gobbles them up, laughing.
Where is my slipper?
The slipper floated off and circles near the ceiling.
The slipper floated off and now circles the cabin like a tiny satellite. {fr} chases it!
Helmet back to front!
{rival} puts the helmet on back to front and sees only heels.
{rival} puts the helmet on back to front and sees only heels. "Lovely stars!" says {rival}.
final: Three, two, one, hooray!
The rocket takes off, and {name} waves to the stars.
Three, two, one! {npc} lifts off, {crowd} clap, and {name} and {fr} wave to the stars from the window.
Space is ours, friends!
{rival} gives everyone a little star, and we fly together.
{rival} gives everyone a little star, and now the friends are a new space crew. Off we go!

sz: Sixty stars shine as skies zoom!

open: We are in the park!
{name} and {fr} go {place_to}.
Today is {event}! {npc} polishes his glasses, and {crowd} hide behind the ferns.
Stomp, stomp, stomp!
The ground shakes: {rival} is coming to the parade!
The ground trembles: {rival} walks to the clearing where {event} will soon begin. {name}, do not be afraid, he is a friend!
Hooray, dinosaurs!
It is quiet among the ferns, and {npc} lays out his maps.
Morning {place_in}: it smells of moss, and {npc} lays out his maps and whispers: "Today we will discover something!"
fact: Hens are dino cousins!
Birds, even ordinary hens, come from dinosaurs.
Did you know? Birds came from dinosaurs, so an ordinary hen is a distant cousin of Tyrannosaurus.
Feathered dinosaurs!
Many dinosaurs had feathers, like birds.
Did you know? Scientists find feather prints on many dinosaurs. Some were as fluffy as chicks.
A banana-long tooth!
A Tyrannosaurus tooth with its root could be longer than a banana.
Did you know? A Tyrannosaurus tooth with its root could reach thirty centimetres, longer than a banana.
A thousand teeth!
Duck-billed dinosaurs had more than a thousand teeth.
Did you know? Some duck-billed dinosaurs had more than a thousand tiny teeth in their mouths, for chewing leaves.
fun: Little arms!
Tyrannosaurus arms are so short they cannot reach its nose.
{rival} cannot scratch his nose: Tyrannosaurus arms are very short. {fr} scratches it with a twig.
The snail hurries!
{npc} crawls to the parade. He set off yesterday.
{npc} crawls to the parade very proudly: he set off yesterday morning. "I am on time!" he says.
A feather-duster tail!
{rival} wags his tail, and all the leaves fly off the tree.
{rival} wags his tail with joy, and all the leaves fly off the tree. It is an autumn waltz in the middle of summer!
Plop!
Something plopped in the swamp, and {fr} jumps with fright.
Something plopped in the swamp, and {fr} jumps: "Is it an egg?" No, it is just a round pebble, and everyone laughs.
final: Hooray, little dinos!
{crowd} clap their paws, and {rival} stomps.
{crowd} clap their paws, {rival} sways everyone with his nose, and {npc} writes in his notebook: "Best day!"
All are friends!
Everyone dances at the parade, and even {rival} twirls.
Everyone dances at the parade, and even {rival} twirls so hard that the ground rocks. It is the merriest parade in the world!

open: We are {place_in}!
{name} and {fr} hurry {place_to}.
Today is {event}! {npc} snorts with a little engine, and {crowd} are already waving flags.
Brrr! Start!
Engines hum, and {npc} winks with headlights.
Engines hum across the whole track, and {npc} winks with headlights. {name}, are you ready for speed?
Hooray, racing!
Morning {place_in}: it smells of rubber and hot tea.
Morning {place_in}: it smells of tyres, the stands are noisy, and {npc} is already at the start. {fr} holds a flag.
fact: Tyres in two seconds!
In Formula 1, the four wheels change in under three seconds.
Did you know? At a pit stop, mechanics change all four wheels of a racing car in under three seconds.
Smooth tyres!
Tyres for a dry track are smooth, with no pattern.
Did you know? On a dry track racing tyres are smooth, with no pattern, to grip the road better.
The first car crawled!
The first car drove as fast as a quick bicycle.
Did you know? The first petrol car, built by Karl Benz, went about as fast as a quick cyclist.
The chequered flag!
A black and white chequered flag means the race is over.
Did you know? When a driver sees the black and white chequered flag, they know it is the finish and the race is over.
fun: Beep-beep!
The horn suddenly sang a song by itself.
The horn suddenly sang a birthday song by itself. {crowd} clap, though it is not their party.
Wipers!
The wipers wave at {crowd}, as if dancing.
The wipers on the window wave at {crowd}, as if dancing. {fr} waves back.
A wheel rolls!
A wheel wanted to play and rolled away down the path.
A wheel wanted to play and rolled away down the path. "Stop!" shouts {rival}, puffing behind it.
Soap bubbles!
At the car wash, {npc} blows soap bubbles from the pipe.
At the car wash {npc} is covered in soap foam and blows bubbles from the exhaust pipe. Everyone roars with laughter!
final: Finish! We are first!
All cross the finish together, and {crowd} clap.
All cross the finish together under the chequered flag, and {crowd} clap. {name} and {fr} jump for joy!
A race for friends!
{rival} shakes hands and invites everyone for a ride.
{rival} toots a friendly horn and invites everyone to drive round the track without a race, just for fun.

open: We are {place_in}!
{name} and {fr} run {place_to}.
Today is {event}! {npc} wags a tail, and {crowd} are already crowding at the gate.
Woof! Meow! Hooray!
The zoo is noisy: everyone is getting ready for the party.
The zoo is noisy and merry: the giraffe brushes its teeth, the baby elephant bathes, and {npc} calls everyone to gather.
Morning {place_in}!
The sun rises, and {npc} greets all the animals.
The sun rises, and {npc} goes round to say hello to all the animals. {name}, are you ready for an adventure?
fact: Giraffe's tongue!
A giraffe's tongue is dark and very long: nearly half a metre.
Did you know? A giraffe's tongue is almost half a metre long, and its dark colour, scientists think, protects it from the sun.
A nose like a fingerprint!
Every dog has a nose with its own pattern, like a fingerprint.
Did you know? Every dog's nose has its own pattern, like people's fingerprints. No two are the same!
Eighteen toes!
A cat has just eighteen toes on its paws.
Did you know? A cat has five toes on each front paw and four on each back paw, eighteen in all.
Wombat cubes!
A wombat leaves marks shaped like little cubes.
Did you know? The wombat is the only animal that leaves marks shaped like little cubes, not balls.
fun: Meow-woof!
{rival} barks like a dog, and the dog meows back.
{rival} suddenly barks like a dog, and the dog nearby meows back. All the animals look at each other, unsure who is who.
Elephant and mouse!
A baby elephant saw a mouse and hid behind a bush.
A baby elephant saw a tiny mouse and hid behind a bush, but its trunk stayed out. {crowd} roar with laughter!
Monkeys!
A little monkey grabbed the spyglass and peeks through it.
A little monkey grabbed the spyglass and now watches the zoo as if at the cinema. "How funny you all are!" it says.
The parrot!
The parrot repeats "Woof!", and everyone laughs.
The parrot repeats everything: "Woof! Woof!" And {rival} purrs back without meaning to, and laughs.
final: Hooray, animals! Friends!
{crowd} jump, and {name} strokes everyone.
{crowd} jump and spin, {npc} barks with joy, and {rival} purrs nearby. {name} strokes everyone.
The party is a hit!
{rival} and {npc} dance together, and everyone claps.
{rival} and {npc} dance side by side like best friends, and {crowd} clap their paws and wings.

open: We are {place_in}!
{name} and {fr} hurry {place_to}.
Today is {event}! {npc} clicks claws, and {crowd} are already swirling at the entrance.
Splash! Hooray!
The waves whisper, and {npc} calls everyone into the water.
The waves whisper softly, the sun sparkles on the water, and {npc} clicks claws and calls everyone to dive.
Morning by the sea!
The shore smells of salt, and {npc} lays out shells.
The shore smells of salt and seaweed, and {npc} lays out shells. {name}, are you ready to dive?
fact: Three hearts!
An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue.
Did you know? An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue because it has a lot of copper.
Otters hold paws!
Sea otters sleep holding paws so they do not drift apart.
Did you know? Sea otters sleep on the water holding each other's paws, so the waves cannot pull them apart.
A crab walks sideways!
A crab walks sideways: it suits its legs best.
Did you know? Crabs walk sideways because their leg joints bend to the side. It is quicker and easier.
A star with no brain!
A starfish has no brain, but crawls to find food.
Did you know? A starfish has no brain, but it still crawls to find food and senses light at the tips of its arms.
fun: A hamster in the water!
{rival} puffs out his cheeks and floats like a buoy.
{rival} fills his cheeks with air and floats on the waves like a buoy. "I am a boat!" he shouts.
Claws!
{npc} wants to hug everyone at once, but catches flippers.
{npc} wants to hug everyone at once, but catches {fr}'s flippers in the claws. They spin in a funny dance.
Blub-blub!
A little fish blows bubbles and sings "la-la-la" underwater.
A little fish blows bubbles and sings underwater. It comes out as "blub-blub-la", and {crowd} roar with laughter.
Little octopus!
An octopus put socks on all eight arms.
An octopus put socks on all eight arms and cannot remember which is the left one. "All right ones!" it decides.
final: Hooray, the sea! Friends!
{crowd} swirl, and {name} and {fr} laugh.
{crowd} swirl in a ring, {npc} clicks claws in time, and {name} and {fr} dance on the sand.
A party by the water!
{rival} gives everyone a shell, and all are happy.
{rival} puffs out his cheeks and gives everyone a shell. Now the shore has the kindest party ever!

open: The stage waits!
Evening, light, music: everything sparkles {place_in} today!
{name} and {fr} step backstage: the lights sparkle {place_in}, and {npc} is already warming up at the barre.
The show is soon!
Tomorrow is {event}: {npc} twirls with joy!
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} twirls round the hall in a cloud-soft tutu, and {crowd} are already taking their seats.
Tap-tap-tap!
Pointe shoes tap the floor: tap-tap-tap! It is {npc}.
Can you hear "tap-tap-tap"? It is {npc} rehearsing {place_in}, and {name} and {fr} hurry to watch.
fact: Sleeps on one leg.
Did you know? A flamingo often sleeps on one leg!
Did you know? A flamingo often sleeps standing on one leg: it keeps the legs warm and lets them rest in turns. A real ballet pose!
A toe like a rock.
The toe of a pointe shoe is hard: it is glued from layers of cloth.
Do you know what pointe shoes are made of? The toe is glued from layers of cloth, so a ballerina can stand on the tips of her toes!
French words.
Ballet words are French: "plié" means "bent".
Almost all ballet words are French. "Plié" means "bent", and "jeté" means "thrown": a leap like a throw!
The Nutcracker.
The Nutcracker was first shown in St Petersburg in 1892.
Did you know? The ballet The Nutcracker, with music by Tchaikovsky, was first shown in St Petersburg in 1892, and people still dance it today!
fun: Boom! Oops!
{rival} tries a pirouette and spins like a top!
{rival} tries a pirouette, but spins like a top and ends up inside the curtain. Oops!
Atishoo!
The dusty curtain tickles a nose: atishoo! Everyone laughs.
The dusty curtain makes {fr} sneeze so loudly that the spectators think the orchestra has a new drum.
Hop! A leap!
{name} leapt, and everyone claps!
{name} made such a big leap that {fr} whispers: "That is not ballet, it is flying!"
Ribbons in a knot!
The pointe-shoe ribbons tangled in a knot: what a bow!
The ribbons tangled into a huge bow, and {npc} dances like a birthday present. Everyone roars with laughter!
final: Hooray! Applause!
The hall claps, flowers fly, and {npc} takes a bow!
The curtain falls, the hall stands and claps, and {npc}, {name} and {fr} bow together. {rival} claps loudest of all!
Bravo, dancers!
Everyone dances together, even {rival} twirls with joy!
The music plays, the lights sparkle, and everyone dances together: {npc}, {rival}, {name} and {fr}. What a party!

open: Hush! Music!
Today {place_in} all the instruments sing: la-la-la!
Today {place_in} the violins, trumpets and flutes are tuning up. {event} is soon, and {npc} skips across the notes with joy!
The concert is soon!
{event} is soon, and {npc} already sings do-re-mi!
{event} is soon! {npc} is so excited that "do-re-mi" comes out in every way, and {crowd} are already heading in.
Ding-dong! La!
Someone is tapping the keys: it is {npc} learning a song.
From behind the doors: do-re-mi-fa-sol! It is {npc} learning a new song, and {name} and {fr} run to listen.
fact: Mozart at five!
Mozart started writing music at about five!
Did you know? The composer Mozart began writing music when he was only about five, almost like you!
Two songs, one tune.
Twinkle, Twinkle and the alphabet song have one tune!
Did you know? "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" and the alphabet song share one tune, which came from an old French song.
The wolf is horns!
In Peter and the Wolf, the bird is a flute and the duck is an oboe.
In the tale Peter and the Wolf, every character is an instrument: the bird is a flute, the duck an oboe, the cat a clarinet, and the wolf horns.
88 keys!
A piano has 88 keys and over two hundred strings inside!
Did you know? A piano has 88 keys and more than two hundred strings inside, struck by little hammers.
fun: Pfffff! Oops!
{rival} blows the trumpet, and out comes a funny "pffff"!
{rival} blows the trumpet with all might, but instead of music out comes "pffff", like from a balloon!
Tra-la-la!
{npc} hops across the keys, and a song comes out!
{npc} skips over the piano keys, and a real song comes out, about a cat who is afraid of the drum.
Boom-boom! Bang!
{fr} bangs the drum: boom! Everyone jumps!
{fr} taps the drum softly, but out comes a "boom" for the whole hall. Even {crowd} jump on their chairs!
Ding-ding! La!
{tool} rings a note, and all sing in their own way!
{fr} picks up {tool_acc} and asks: "Let's all sing 'la'!" The choir comes out so united that {npc} giggles.
final: Hooray! A concert!
Everyone sings together, and the hall rings with joy!
The hall roars with applause, and {npc} and {rival} sing a duet while {name} and {fr} conduct. What a concert!
Music, hooray!
{rival} and {npc} play together, and it is a wonder!
{crowd} stand and clap: the last song fills the whole hall! {name}, {fr}, {npc} and {rival} bow.

open: Quiet! Thinking!
Today it is quiet {place_in}: everyone is thinking about a move.
Today it is so quiet {place_in} that you can hear {npc} think. {event} is soon, and all the pieces are set up!
Chess waits!
{event} is soon: the boards shine, the pieces stand in rows.
Tomorrow is {event}! The boards shine, the pieces stand in tidy rows, and {crowd} take out notebooks of puzzles.
Knight's move!
{npc} sets up the pieces and mutters: "Knight's move!"
{name} and {fr} walk {place_to}, and {npc} is already setting up the pieces, muttering: "What a puzzle!"
fact: Chess is 1500 years old.
Chess was invented in India more than a thousand years ago.
Did you know? Chess was born in India about fifteen hundred years ago, and then the game was called "chaturanga".
The rook is a tower.
The rook looks like a tower and moves in straight lines.
Did you know? The rook looks like a castle tower, and it moves only in straight lines, as if on rails.
A pawn becomes a queen!
When a pawn reaches the far edge, it becomes a strong queen!
Did you know? If a little pawn reaches the other side of the board, it turns into almost any piece, for example a queen.
The famous cube!
Ernő Rubik invented the cube and took a month to solve it!
Did you know? The Hungarian Ernő Rubik invented his cube in 1974 and took a whole month to solve it. What a puzzle!
fun: Where is the pawn?
{rival} hides a pawn in his cheek, and it puffs up!
{rival} hides a pawn in his cheek, but the cheek puffs up so funnily that the whole hall sees where the piece went.
Thinking... Phew!
{npc} thinks a minute, then another minute, then has tea.
{npc} thinks about a move, and thinks, and thinks, so long that {fr} has time to drink tea and count all the squares on the board.
The knight goes in an L!
The knight jumps in an L shape: what a dance!
The knight moves in an L shape, and {name} tries it too, but trips over their own feet. Everyone laughs!
The magnifier! Wow!
{tool} magnifies a pawn: now it is as big as an elephant!
Through {tool_acc} the pawn looks huge as an elephant, and {fr} whispers: "What a fighter!"
final: Hooray! A draw!
Nobody lost: {rival} and {npc} laugh together!
The game ends in a draw, which is best of all: {rival} and {npc} roar with laughter, and {crowd} clap.
Hooray, a win!
We found the answer, and everyone claps!
{name} and {fr} find the right move, and the puzzle is solved! {npc} hoots with joy, and {rival} wants to see it.

open: Mmm, yummy!
What a lovely smell {place_in}: vanilla and cinnamon!
What a lovely smell {place_in}! Vanilla, cinnamon and fresh bread: {npc} is baking for the party, and {event} is soon!
The fair is soon!
{event} is soon! The dough rises like a cloud.
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} kneads dough and whips cream, and {crowd} are already licking their lips in the queue.
Bang! Flour!
Bang! A sack of flour fell, and all is white as winter!
Bang! A sack of flour falls on the floor, and the whole kitchen goes white as in winter. {npc} laughs: "Let's start!"
fact: Yeast is alive!
Yeast eats sugar and makes bubbles, and the dough grows!
Did you know? Yeast is a tiny living fungus: it eats sugar and makes bubbles of gas, and that makes dough rise.
Honey keeps.
Honey hardly ever spoils: it was found in Egyptian tombs!
Did you know? Honey hardly ever spoils: pots of honey about three thousand years old were found in ancient Egyptian tombs.
Popcorn goes pop!
A popcorn kernel bursts when a tiny drop of water boils.
Did you know? Inside a corn kernel there is a tiny drop of water: it heats up, turns to steam, and the kernel bursts with a pop.
Egg white is like foam!
Whisk egg white, and it turns into white foam!
Did you know? If you whisk egg white for long, air bubbles get trapped in it, and it becomes fluffy foam for meringue.
fun: Meow! Cream!
{rival} licks the cream, and the whole nose is white!
{rival} secretly tastes the cream, and now his nose and whiskers are white. "It was not me!" he purrs.
Blub! Blub!
The dough climbed out of the bowl and crawls across the table!
The dough grows and grows, climbs out of the bowl and crawls across the table, and {fr} catches it with a spoon like a cloud.
Ding-ding!
{tool} whisks so fast that the cream flies to the ceiling!
{tool} whisks the cream so fast that it flies to the ceiling, and {name} catches the drops on a tongue.
Oh, salt!
Salt got in the tea instead of sugar: what a taste!
Salt gets in the cup instead of sugar, and the tea comes out so strange that {npc} wrinkles up a nose and laughs.
final: Hooray! Tuck in!
Everyone sits at the table: tea, pies and laughter!
{crowd} sit at a long table, and {rival} shares the cream with everyone for the first time. What a sweet party!
Yum-yum!
So many treats, and there is enough for all!
{npc} takes rosy buns out of the oven, and {rival} purrs so loudly that {crowd} sing along.

open: Beep-beep-beep!
Today the machines hum and the lights blink {place_in}!
Today the lights blink and little motors whirr {place_in}. {event} is soon, and {npc} checks every screw.
The festival is soon!
{event} is soon! {npc} polishes up until shiny.
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} polishes up until shiny, and {crowd} are already coming to see new wonders of technology.
Ding! Click!
Something clicks under the table: it is {npc} mending an arm!
Someone clicks and clinks under the table. {name} and {fr} peek in: it is {npc} screwing on a new arm!
fact: Robot means work!
The word "robot" comes from the Czech word "robota", which means work.
Did you know? The word "robot" was invented for a play in 1920, and in Czech "robota" means "hard work".
A tough Mars rover!
A Mars rover was meant to work three months, and lasted years!
Did you know? The rover Opportunity was meant to work on Mars for three months, but drove there for almost fourteen years!
The robot knight!
Leonardo da Vinci drew a robot knight long, long ago.
Did you know? More than five hundred years ago, Leonardo da Vinci drew a robot knight whose arms and head moved.
A rover on the Moon!
A rover drove on the Moon, and was steered from Earth.
Did you know? In 1970 Lunokhod drove across the Moon: a robot on wheels steered by people right from Earth.
fun: Meow! A screw!
{rival} chases a screw across the floor like a mouse!
{rival} chases a shiny screw across the floor like a mouse and nearly knocks the robot off its feet.
Atishoo-beep!
{npc} sneezes, and all the lights blink!
{npc} sneezes: "Atishoo-beep!" and all the lights blink, like on a Christmas tree.
The robot dances!
{fr} presses a button, and {npc} starts to dance!
{fr} presses the wrong button by accident, and {npc} suddenly starts to dance right on the table. What a dance!
Zip-zip!
{tool} spins: zip-zip! The nut is tightened.
{fr} picks up {tool_acc}, zip-zip! and tightens every nut in the lab in one minute.
final: Hooray! It works!
The machine hums, the lights blink: all is ready!
Everyone starts the machine together: it hums, blinks and sings! {crowd} clap, and {rival} purrs nearby.
Beep-beep-hooray!
{npc} and {rival} shake hands and paws!
{rival} admits that {npc} is a great inventor, and {name} and {fr} turn in the last screw.

open: Paint, hooray!
Today {place_in} smells of paint and bright ideas!
Today {place_in} smells of paint, and pictures dry on the walls. {event} is soon, and {npc} is already hopping across the palette!
The show is soon!
{event} is soon! {npc} mixes the brightest paints.
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} mixes the brightest paints, and {crowd} are already peeking in at the windows.
Splat! Paint!
Splat! A rainbow patch appeared on the floor!
Splat! A rainbow patch suddenly appears on the floor, and {npc} giggles: "I did it by accident!"
fact: Hands on the rock!
Ancient people painted hands on rocks, thousands of years ago!
Did you know? People painted even in caves: the walls still hold handprints about forty thousand years old.
Mona Lisa is small.
The Mona Lisa is quite small: under a metre tall!
Did you know? The famous Mona Lisa is not huge at all: it is under a metre tall, yet thousands of people come to see it.
Blue was like gold!
Blue paint was made from stone and cost as much as gold!
Did you know? Long ago bright blue paint was made from the precious stone lapis lazuli, and it cost as much as gold.
Blue plus yellow!
Blue and yellow together make green!
Did you know? If you mix blue and yellow paint you get green, and red and yellow make orange.
fun: Woof! Paws!
{rival} steps in paint and leaves flower-shaped prints!
{rival} steps in blue paint and runs over the paper, leaving a whole trail of paw prints. What a picture!
Oh! Noses!
{fr} sneezes over the paint, and everyone has a yellow nose!
{fr} sneezes loudly over a pot of yellow paint, and everyone gets yellow freckles on their noses.
Whiskers! Whiskers!
{npc} paints whiskers on every picture, even the Moon!
{npc} loves painting so much that whiskers get added to every portrait, even the sun in a landscape. What a laugh!
Boom! The easel!
{tool} wobbles, and all the pictures tilt sideways!
{tool} wobbles like a ship, and all the pictures tilt sideways. "Now it is modern art!" laughs {fr}.
final: Hooray! The show!
All the pictures hang on the walls and shine!
Pictures shine on the walls, and {crowd} stroll round smiling. {rival} leaves the funniest paw prints on the floor.
Paint together!
Everyone takes paints and paints one big picture!
{name}, {fr}, {npc} and {rival} paint a huge picture, and {crowd} add a brushstroke each. A rainbow appears!

open: A castle! Hooray!
Today {place_in} candles flicker, and fairies sew dresses.
Today {place_in} candles flicker, and unicorns comb their manes. {event} is soon, and {npc} sends up golden sparks!
The ball is soon!
{event} is soon! {npc} shines up the scales.
Tomorrow is {event}! {npc} polishes scales until they shine, and {crowd} flutter through the halls hanging garlands.
Knock-knock-knock!
Someone knocks at the castle gate: it is {npc}!
Someone knocks softly at the castle gate: knock-knock! {name} and {fr} open it, and there stands {npc} with a bouquet.
fact: A horn is a tooth!
A unicorn's horn was a narwhal's tusk, and that is a tooth!
Did you know? Long ago, long narwhal tusks were sold as unicorn horns, but really a tusk is a huge tooth of a sea whale.
A mermaid is a manatee?
Sailors once mistook manatees for mermaids.
Did you know? Old sailors sometimes mistook manatees for mermaids: they swim slowly and hold their babies to the chest.
A dragon is a lizard!
On Komodo island live big lizards called dragons!
Did you know? On the Indonesian island of Komodo live huge lizards, Komodo dragons, and people call them dragons too.
Wings of ten metres!
A giant pterosaur had a wingspan of about ten metres.
Did you know? Pterosaurs were not dinosaurs, but they flew above them: the biggest had a wingspan of about ten metres.
fun: Wow! Hats!
{rival} flaps wings, and all the hats fly into the sky!
{rival} spreads huge wings, and all the guests' hats fly off like birds. Everyone catches them and roars with laughter.
Atishoo! Bubbles!
{npc} sneezes, and rainbow bubbles fly out!
{npc} sneezes loudly, and instead of fire, colourful bubbles fly out of the snout, and {fr} catches them in a hat.
Splash! A frog!
{name} waves a hand, and the boot croaks!
{name} waves a hand to call the stars, but a frog in a bow tie appears instead. Ribbit!
Neigh! A rainbow!
The unicorn snorts, and a rainbow appears in the air.
The unicorn snorts, and a tiny rainbow suddenly appears in the air. {fr} tries to slide down it like a slide.
final: Hooray! The ball!
Lanterns glow, music plays, the party has begun!
Lanterns flash over the hall, and {npc}, {rival}, {name} and {fr} start a dance together.
A fairy tale! Hooray!
{npc} and {rival} fly over the castle, and all wave!
{npc} and {rival} soar over the castle and draw rainbow hearts in the sky. Below, {crowd} wave and cheer.

powers.d: Speaks so clearly that any door opens.
use: Voice power! Open!
{name} speaks clearly, and everything opens!
Voice power works: {name} speaks so clearly that locks click and doors swing open by themselves!
One word, path clear!
One clear word, and the path is clear!
{name} says one clear word, and even the most stubborn door politely opens.
One, two, done!
{name} counts faster than lightning!
Lightning count! In one second {name} counts all that is needed and finds the right answer.
The answer is ready!
Everyone is thinking, and {name} already knows the answer!
Everyone is still counting on fingers, and {name} has already counted. Lightning would be jealous!

powers.d: Draws, and the drawing comes alive.
use: I draw, it lives!
{name} draws, and the drawing comes alive!
Living drawing! {name} draws just what is needed, and the drawing jumps off the paper and helps.
Swish, and there it is!
A few lines, and the drawing is already real!
{name} draws a few lines, the drawing winks and becomes real. What a power!

powers.d: Reads any signs, tracks and maps.
use: I see a sign!
{name} reads signs that nobody else sees!
Sign power! {name} spots tiny tracks and signs and reads them like an open book.
Here is a clue!
{name} reads the tracks: this way!
To everyone else they are just smudges, but {name} reads a clue in them: this way!
Whoosh! I am here!
{name} dashes faster than the wind!
Faster than the wind! {name} zooms past so fast that the wind looks round in surprise.
One, two, there!
A second, and {name} is already there!
Before anyone blinks, {name} is already there, waving: all is well!

powers.d: Understands the language of animals and birds.
use: The birds will help!
{name} asks the animals to help, and they come!
Friend of animals! {name} talks to birds and animals in their own language, and they hurry to help.
They will tell me!
A sparrow whispers, and {name} understands it all.
A little sparrow chirps, and {name} understands everything: it saw where we need to go!
I will lift it!
{name} gently lifts the heavy thing!
Kind strength! {name} lifts a huge weight so gently that nothing falls or breaks.
With one hand!
Heavy? {name} lifts it like a feather!
Everyone puffs, but {name} lifts it with one hand, like a feather, and sets it down neatly.

powers.d: Glows in the dark and sees everything.
use: Light! I see!
{name} glows, and the dark is gone!
Light power! {name} begins to shine like a torch, and even the darkest corner becomes clear.
It is light now!
{name} shines and shows the way.
Dark is no trouble: {name} glows with a warm light, and the shadows scatter like mice.

puzzle: You solved a hard puzzle not long ago, and that will help now!
Not long ago {name} solved a hard puzzle. Today that cleverness is just what we need!
math: You counted so fast not long ago, and that will help now!
Not long ago {name} counted so fast in the game that today the numbers obey by themselves!
chess: Chess taught you to think a move ahead!
Not long ago {name} played chess. Thinking two moves ahead is the main thing today!
read: You read a lot not long ago, and now it is all clear!
Not long ago {name} read so well that today reading any sign is a piece of cake!
story: Remember the story you heard? It gives a clue!
{name} heard a story not long ago, and now knows what will be very useful!
draw: You drew not long ago, and your eye got sharp!
Not long ago {name} drew, and now notices every little thing, like a real artist.
dance: You danced not long ago, and your feet are light!
Not long ago {name} danced, and now the feet are light and nimble, just right for this job!
music: You played music not long ago, and your ear got sharp!
Not long ago {name} played music, and now can hear even the quietest sound.
speech: You practised sounds, and your voice got strong!
{name} practised sounds not long ago, and the voice became ringing and clear. That will help!
